title: Usage ledger per job, in credits only for credit workspaces
gap: Usage (WorkspaceView.tsx:233-256) shows only per-model bar totals. When the models list is empty it falls back to provider USD, and the AssetInspector 'Settled' fact (AssetInspector.tsx:34) can also show '$'. There is no per-job list of what was charged, held or not billed.
target: Extend /api/usage with ?rows=1 to return paged generation rows (when, who, engine, credits, status, including 'Failed · not billed' and 'Held'). Render them under the bars with a month filter and a CSV export. Credit workspaces never see USD.
respects_rules: Read-only ledger. Deleted takes keep their cost rows, as the ledger already requires.
